item.title: US board game industry eyes lengthy refund war following tariff decision
item.description: The US Supreme Court has ruled controversial global tariffs unlawful in a 6-3 decision, but American tabletop publishers view this as just the next battle in an ongoing war.

item.title: Routinely Itemised: RPG #349
item.description: A short month packed with TTRPG developments: We cover the passing of Patrick Campbell, the US board game tariff situation, and new releases like Skies Above. Explore the latest RPG tips and a curated summary of reviews and interviews.

item.title: Merchoid opens pre-orders for limited edition metal Transformers Matrix of Leadership
item.description: Merchoid has opened pre-orders for a limited edition metal replica of the Matrix of Leadership from the Transformers franchise, priced at £27.99.

item.title: From Elizabeth Moon to Aaron Allston: How Surbrook Press builds encyclopaedic RPG worlds
item.description: Veteran RPG writer Michael Surbrook discusses his upcoming portal fantasy setting Well of the Worlds and adapting beloved literary universes for the tabletop.

item.title: Audio EXP Podcast #322: Tariffs, Tech Roadmaps, and Tic Tac Toe
item.description: Ryan Dancey leaves AEG over an AI dispute, PaizoCon 2026 takes a hiatus, and D&D Beyond rebuilds its engine. Girdy breaks down the week in tabletop gaming.

item.title: Small Folk in Big Coats: A collaborative struggle for sartorial supremacy
item.description: A new roleplaying games zine, Small Folk in Big Coats, challenges players to pilot a trench coat while pursuing secret, conflicting goals.

item.title: New Dungeons & Dragons job openings signal a major digital shift
item.description: Wizards of the Coast is hiring for several Dungeons & Dragons roles, focusing on a major rebuild of the D&D Beyond platform and new game design talent.

item.title: Rob Grant returns to Red Dwarf with prequel novel Titan
item.description: Red Dwarf: Titan is the first new novel in 30 years. Series co-creator Rob Grant returns to the mining ship for a prequel adventure set on Saturn's moon.

item.title: Review: The Creative Game Master’s Guide to Extraordinary Locations: & How to Design Them
item.description: Duncan Rhodes applies travel writing expertise to roleplaying games in this review of thirty original fantasy locations. Discover how real world geography creates session sustaining set pieces for 5e and beyond.

item.title: Genre Police: Lost In Static
item.description: "Help! My player won't leave the inn!" We break down the four types of passive players and how to engage them without railroading.
